Benefit: It is related with Gold Nuggets and Gemstone.
Effect: Mining Assistance
Increase the amount of Gold Nuggets and Gemstones gained.
However, the cost of mining will be increased by 10 times.
Duration: for 1 hour.

First, use the item
Second, Sit or kneel near the bonfire with your fleet members for about 20 sec. and you and the other fleet players can trigger the effect.
You can check the termination time at Journal>Special Item Effects in game.
